cases.case_label: Homozygous Alu in exon 9 of MAK
cases.mechanism_detail: Patient iPSCs homozygous for an Alu insertion in MAK exon 9 lack the retinal MAK transcript and protein; HDR correction of the Alu restored both.
cases.quote: We developed a homology-directed repair strategy targeting a homozygous Alu insertion in exon 9 of male germ cell-associated kinase (MAK) and demonstrated restoration of the retinal transcript and protein in patient cells.
